comment: Curated list of known switchbay packs. The daemon serves this via /api/packs/registry; the Settings UI shows it under Extension packs → Browse available. Each entry: name, description, source (git URL or `bundled:<dirname>` for packs shipped in switchbay itself), version, requires_extra (Python deps that need pip install on activate, surfaces a confirm dialog). Authors: open a PR against this file to add a pack — anyone can also run their own registry by overriding the daemon's CSWY_PACK_REGISTRY env var.

packs.name: owid
packs.title: Our World in Data
packs.description: Browse OWID charts, import a chart's data into the workspace as a CSV, and get a starter Vega-Lite plot — refine it in the Plot tab or query it in the Table tab. No API key or install.
